Deepal S09 EREV launched in China: 210 km CLTC electric range, 1.5T range extender
The Deepal S09 is Changan Deepal's flagship six-seat SUV. The EREV version uses a 1.5T range extender and a 41.2 kWh battery, giving a CLTC pure electric range of 210 km.
The rear-wheel-drive EREV accelerates from 0 to 100 km/h in 7.5 seconds.
